_README: Copy this file to tunnels.json and fill in your real values, then run: tunnelctl sync
tunnels.json is gitignored (it holds your private infra). This example is safe to commit.
BASTIONS: define each bastion once under "bastions" as an alias ->
Each bastion can live in a DIFFERENT GCP project (set "project" per bastion).
If a bastion omits "project", it falls back to defaults.project.
Tunnels then reference the alias by name in their "bastion" field.
name         (required) unique id; becomes launchd label <prefix>.<name> and log file names
local_port   (required) port on 127.0.0.1 your DB client connects to (must be unique)
remote_host  (required) target DB IP/host as seen from the bastion
remote_port  (required) target DB port (e.g. 5432 postgres, 27017 mongo)
bastion      (required) bastion ALIAS defined under "bastions" (zone/project come from it)
ssh_opts     (optional) overrides defaults.ssh_opts (array of ssh args)
NOTE: infra only. Do NOT put DB passwords here; keep them in your DB client.
